method: pdftoppm at 120 dpi and actual view_image inspection of each final rendered page

observations.1: Title, affiliation, abstract, definitions, cited context and main theorem are readable. The inequality 1265 versus 1266 and bounded novelty wording render correctly; no clipping or overlap.

observations.4: All nine permutation/square pairs and the full two-row count table are readable; commas distinguish 10 and 11, b_0 remains undefined. Table values match exact parsed source data. Both method citations and scope/assistance disclosures are visible.
